content: »Neuxei, tukari kanaye'aximeniri, teeka ha'aritsietɨ hepaɨ 'anetɨ. Yunaitɨ memɨteyukatawe'erie meta 'axateyuruwamete xatsi hepaɨ mepɨ'aneneni, hikɨ mɨkɨ tukaritsie mekanititaiyariekuni wananari tɨma pɨkayuhayewa —Yawé Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye mɨpaɨ kanaineni—.
Peru xeme matsi xemɨnetsi'ayemakaxe xehetsiemieme, tita mɨtiheitserie nehetsɨa miemekɨ xepɨhekɨariyarieni, mɨkɨ hekɨariyakɨ
xepanayexɨrieni. Hikɨ xeme xetixɨnarieme, xekanayekɨnikuni xe'utitsukwakatɨ tsikerutsixi memɨxɨxɨni hepaɨ 'ɨxapa.
Mɨkɨ tukaritsie nemikuha'aritɨwatsie xeme 'axateyuruwamete xekaniwatiketsikuni, xe'ɨkate hetɨa tumuanari mepɨhɨkɨtɨni —Yawé Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye mɨpaɨ kanaineni—.
»Muitsexi neti'uximayatsiriwame 'aitsikate kemɨraka'utɨa xekena'eriwani. Xekena'eriwani 'aitsikate meta 'inɨari niukiyarite nemɨxeyetuiri Huré hɨriyaritsie yunaime 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme.
»'Ari neniukame 'Eriyaxi nekananunɨ'amɨkɨ mexi 'akuxi Yawé tukarieya ka'aye'aweni, mɨkɨ tukari mɨmariwe meta mumariwekare.
Mɨkɨ yakatiniyurimɨkɨ hipatɨ yuniwema wahamatɨa memɨyutaxewirekɨ meta hipatɨ yupaapama wahamatɨa, xɨka mɨpaɨ me'uyɨni nepɨka'ayeneniri kwie 'axamɨ'ane ne'ipitɨanike meta naime netika'unake».
